'''Belnala''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Belnala was an influential member of the [[Kajidier]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
